# Burner: a dark grate ring on the stove top and a ring of pastel flame just under the pan's
# edge (emissive: unlit). Origin at the stove top under the pan. Generated by make_env.py. Up Z.
new
material new Grate --base-color 0.4235 0.3373 0.4431 --no-slot
material new Flame --base-color 1.0000 0.7647 0.5176 --emission 1.0000 0.7647 0.5176 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Grate --vertices 12 --radius 0.36 --depth 0.04 --location 0 0 0.02
material assign Grate
add mesh torus --name Flame --major-segments 12 --minor-segments 4 --major-radius 0.4 --minor-radius 0.045 --location 0 0 0.05
material assign Flame
shade flat
select all
shade flat
export burner.glb
